title: Question on the page "instantsearch"
body:
Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js. I could not find what I was looking for on the page "[instantsearch](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/instantsearch.html

I am trying to automatically re-run the search only if the first attempt produces no results - trying to remove some applied refinements.
I understand that the only event raised from the search is "render" but it obviously runs only after all the widget have been rendered.
Is there any event before render and just after the search (e.g. search completed) that I can handle and in which I can check the results and possibly change the refinements (and re-run the search again)?
If not, how can I manage this scenario?

Thanks

comments.body: Perfect, feel free to open a new issue if you have any other questions!
